messages:
harper (Marketing): Uploaded the latest launch post draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-draft. Need a quick pass on: audience hooks (PM vs infra), benchmark copy, and webinar CTA routing. Short replies pls :eyes:

omar (Product): Two hero variants make sense. PM TL;DR suggestion: 'Ship LLM features faster — Redwood removes serving friction so product teams ship in days, not months.'

lee (Growth): Recommend single HubSpot form + hidden segment field. Use URL param ?seg=pm or ?seg=infra to set it. Workflows: wf_900_pm, wf_900_infra.

zoe (Design): I can build two hero variants and a compact features->buyer table. ETA ~2 hours.

maya (Legal): Quick redline: avoid absolutes. Use "up to" for numeric claims, include a benchmark link + short methodology, and add a one-line disclaimer like "Results may vary by workload and deployment."

devon (Product): Draft benchmark line: "Internal tests show up to 25% lower per-token latency vs standard A100 baseline and up to 30% lower per-request GPU cost (internal benchmark, May 2026). See methodology link in the post."

harper (Marketing): Thanks — maya: ok with devon's wording if we link the methodology and add the disclaimer? Also webinar seats = 250. lee, can we flip CTA copy to 'Join waitlist' at 230?

lee (Growth): Yep — will set seat_threshold=230, hard_cap=250; launch-bot can post progress to #marketing. We'll swap CTA via CMS when threshold reached.

launch-bot: Registration thresholds configured: threshold=230, capacity=250. Will post at 200, 230, and when full.

harper (Marketing): Great. I'll fold the edits and re-upload by EOD. If no blockers we send to comms for copy lock tomorrow morning. :rocket:
